name: Grand-Nya
source:
Hinako eats, and does not cook. Aysu cooks, and does not eat.

This catgirl and moonlight vampire have been married for quite some time, and complete each other, like sun and moon. But in a cosy afternoon full of memories, and Aysu cooking for the woman she loves, there is something not quite right. 

Aysu knows what it is, just like she knows exactly what her wife is craving, every time. Even so, maybe you can help give her a nudge in the right direction.

[from [url=https://sad-ghost-studios.itch.io/grandnya]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
日菜子只吃饭，不做饭。阿苏做饭，不吃饭。

这个猫女和月光吸血鬼结婚已经有一段时间了，相得益彰，就像太阳和月亮一样。但在一个充满回忆的舒适下午，艾苏为她所爱的女人做饭，却有些不太对劲。

艾苏知道那是什么，就像她每次都清楚地知道她妻子渴望什么一样。即便如此，也许你可以帮助她走向正确的方向。

[来自[url=https://sad-ghost-studios.itch.io/grandnya]itch.io[/url]]
